verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote-desktop service that handles user session data, so whether that data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training policies, opt-outs, or data-use controls. The CLI, REST API and breach-related community items are off-topic for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
